gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-days-one: Commanding in its high midline and generous side gaps, Metamorphous leads, while Days One fills each line with big, rope-ladder-spaced letters. Pair them with a large heading and a modest body size.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-epunda-sans: Metamorphous carries a high midline and a soft shift from heavy stems to lighter curves, and Epunda Sans follows in a plain sans with oversized, light-filled counters. Its openness is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-farro: Farro is a sans with short ascenders and no stroke contrast at all. Under Metamorphous, with its gentle fat-and-slim modulation and wide sidebearings, the heading gets all the ornament and the text stays out of its way.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads like nails lined up on a ruler, a monospace with a tall waist line and no thick-and-thin slowing the eye. Metamorphous above it adds a tempered, commanding modulation.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-geist-mono: Code-style, spaced out, and built like bent tubing. Metamorphous brings a mild letterpress-slug contrast on top, so a long run of Geist Mono below feels measured, with its high lowercase and wide side gaps moving the eye steadily along.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-genos: Distinctive from the first line, Metamorphous sets a high midline and wide sidebearings against Genos, a plain sans with letters pressed so close their edges almost kiss. And over a long passage, Genos reads smoothly, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-geom: A high-set midline and soft, hand-inked modulation give Metamorphous its commanding character. Geom follows with a lofty lowercase band in sans-serif form, and the difference in manner is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One is a plain sans whose rounded strokes look like cut lengths of cord, with capitals barely taller than lowercase. Hammersmith One against Metamorphous, with its slight but visible stroke contrast, makes the pair's difference in line quality its strongest point.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-inder: Professional in tone, Inder is a plain sans with little height difference between its cases. And Metamorphous above it adds medium contrast without sharp hairlines, giving the page a commanding top and a tidy, quiet text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Wide sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous its distinctive, commanding look, while Kdam Thmor Pro is a modern sans-serif with bowls filling the line. One makes a statement; the other keeps text moving.
